verdicts.correction: The core of the rule holds. KIS uses the Bank of Korea's 2025 preliminary per-capita GNI of KRW 52,416,000 for applications from 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31, and all the derived multiples check out (0.6x 31,449,600; 0.7x 36,691,200; 0.8x 41,932,800; 1.5x 78,624,000; 2x 104,832,000; 3x 157,248,000; 4x 209,664,000). Two fixes are needed. (a) Only one non-primary relay (gnscfw) supports the E-7 carve-out. Its wording ('특정활동(E-7) 자격에 한해') limits it to the E-7 status's own requirements, so it does not reach F-2 or F-5 tests (F-2-T included). (b) If the carve-out is modelled, the 2024 GNI is KRW 49,955,000 (BOK: 4995만5000원), not 49,950,000. Since 2025-04 the E-7 wage floors are fixed annual amounts set by notice, not GNI multiples, so the carve-out affects little.
verdicts.source: BOK 2025 annual national accounts (preliminary), 2026-03-10, as reported by heraldk.com/dailian.co.kr (WebSearch extract); gnscfw.org/1303 (relay of the HiKorea notice); kowork.kr E-7 2025/2026 wage notice summaries

discrepancyVerdicts.correction: The proposed text is right on income: household >= 1x GNI with own share >= 50%, and 80% / 70% / 60% (KRW 41.9M / 36.7M / 31.4M) since 2026-02-12. Two changes: the asset alternative must read 'OWN net assets >= the average household net assets' (KRW 471.4M), and add the community-leader route (head of a recognised Korean organisation or company, recommended by the head of a Korean mission). KIIP not required: confirmed.
Agreed: household 2x GNI (KRW 104.8M) or net assets of 1.5x the average (KRW 707.2M), not combinable, no reduction. Mark the own-share >= 50% part as practitioner-sourced.

Remove '(1x if you came via E-7-S2)': no basis was found. Change '3+ years on F-2-7' to '3+ years on a points-based F-2 (F-2-7, F-2-7S or F-2-T)' (decree 제13호). Keep '2x GNI or net assets of 1.5x the average'. Present 'own income only' as likely rather than certain (lead-level).

Add 'no asset alternative' (the manual's F-5-13 list has no asset document, and it has no basic-knowledge document either). Do not assert 'own pension only' or restate 2x GNI as verified: both are lead-level.
Agreed for F-5-9 and F-5-15: the asset document is in the list and the basic-knowledge document is absent. The 1x GNI amount stays unverified.
Add the asset route, and also add that minors under 15, or 15+ in regular schooling, are exempt from KIIP (manual note on the F-5-4 list).

Agreed for F-5-18 and F-5-29: add the asset route and the minors' KIIP exemption. But F-5-29 (and F-5-S2) also REQUIRE KIIP: their manual lists include the basic-knowledge document, yet data/visamap.yaml has no 'lang' for F-5-29 or F-5-S2. Add lang {kiip: 5} with the minors' exemption.
Agreed: 'income of 2x GNI or net assets of 1.5x the average household'. No KIIP (no basic-knowledge document).
There is no manual entry. Neither the 70% nor the 100% figure, nor the own-only limit, was verified. The H-2 issuance stop is confirmed.

The manual's F-2-3 lists (change, abroad, extend) ask only for the spouse's letter of guarantee, financial or income proof and credit report, with no stated multiple. Nothing found supports '70% for up to 3 people'. Remove it, or mark it unverified.

Not 'correct as is'. The 1x GNI sponsor-income condition applies to F-2-7 holders only, and below it the family gets F-1. Family of an F-2-7S (K-STAR / potential talent) holder gets F-2-71 under a separate manual case with no sponsor income certificate.
3x GNI (KRW 157.2M) and the in-Korea change at 2x (KRW 104.8M) are supported. The '4x lets you drop a leg' clause is not verified. Use KRW 52,416,000 (not the E-7 carve-out) for F-2-T.
Agreed: F-5-6R has no manual entry, and its code, the 2-year clause and KIIP 5 are unsourced. Verify before showing.
Agreed: 1x GNI = KRW 52,416,000 for applications 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 (KRW 49,955,000 before), judged on taxed income of the previous calendar year on the 소득금액증명.
The fixed KRW 40M waiver is not re-checked against the 2026 manual or 고시.
Agreed: the base rule matches the manual. The relaxations are unverified and should not be added.

notes:
I used all 16 WebSearch calls. Official sources came up only through search extracts: the MOJ F-4 merger release, the MOJ/korea.kr Top-Tier release, the KIS Visa Navigator and the BOK GNI reports. The rest of the checking relied on data/visadocs.yaml, the transcribed manual lists, which settle the questions of which document appears for which code.

Settled:
- 1x GNI = KRW 52,416,000 for applications 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. The 2024 figure is 49,955,000, not 49,950,000.
- The 80% / 70% / 60% income cuts are F-5-6 only.
- The asset route exists for F-5-1, -4, -9, -15, -16, -18, -26, -28, -29 and -S2. It does not exist for F-5-10, -13, -24 or -T.
- F-5-24 and F-5-T1 have no income test.
- F-5-10 tests the applicant's own wage.
- F-5-29 and F-5-S2 need KIIP, which the data lacks.
- F-2-71's sponsor-income test applies to F-2-7 sponsors only, not F-2-7S.
- Remove 'F-5-16 at 1x GNI via E-7-S2': no source was found.

Still open:
- Whether the F-5-16 / F-5-13 'applicant only' rule exists (practitioner sites only).
- How far the own-share-of-50% rule reaches beyond F-5-6.
- The 1x GNI amounts for F-5-4, -9, -10, -15, -18, -28 and -29.
- The F-5-T income multiple.
- The F-2-T 'drop a leg with 4x' clause.
- F-5-14 (70% or 100%), F-5-2 relaxations, F-5-6R, F-2-R, and the F-2-3 '70% for up to 3 people'.

Several searches returned off-topic results (one on F-5-T returned fighter-jet pages), so the unverifiable verdicts mean 'not found', not 'refuted'.
